seo.title: Temple Aviv Judea
seo.description: Temple Aviv Judea is a vibrant Messianic Jewish congregation in Fullerton where Jewish and Gentile believers worship, learn, and grow together in Yeshua.

hero.title: Ancient roots.
hero.intro: Worship the G-d of Israel, encounter the Jewish Messiah Yeshua, and find your place in a joyful, diverse mishpachah.

heroMedia.imageAlt: A radiant artistic view of Jerusalem and the Temple at sunset

welcome.eyebrow: A bridge, a family, a home
welcome.lead: At Temple Aviv Judea, the walls of partition are broken down. Jewish and Gentile believers come together to honor Shabbat, celebrate the biblical feasts, study the whole Word of G-d, and follow Yeshua within the rich context of Jewish faith.
welcome.body: You do not need to know the liturgy or have the right words before you walk through the door. Come curious. Come hungry. Come ready to be welcomed.

values.title: Prayer
values.text: Drawing near through praise, repentance, expectation, and surrender.

values.title: Proclamation
values.text: Sharing the Good News of Messiah first with Jewish people and also with the Nations.

values.title: People
values.text: Growing as mishpachah through worship, learning, service, and shared life.

storyFeature.imageAlt: Colorful painting of Jacob resting beneath a ladder rising toward Jerusalem, with doves and Hebrew scripture
storyFeature.body: TAJ began as a Bible study that met on Friday nights and became one of the early modern Messianic Jewish congregations. After decades of gathering across Southern California, the congregation found its permanent Fullerton home in 2014. The building was paid off in 2020.

visitPreview.heading: Come expecting more than a service.
visitPreview.intro: Expect ancient liturgy and living music, Davidic dance and biblical teaching, children being blessed, and a meal where conversations become friendships.

items.imageAlt: Colorful painting of a musician in a tallit playing a lyre
items.title: Joyful worship
items.text: Traditional Jewish liturgy, instruments, singing, and dance in a warm, participatory setting.

items.imageAlt: Colorful painting of a shepherd embracing a lamb beneath Hebrew lettering
items.title: Rooted teaching
items.text: A weekly message from Scripture through a Jewish lens, followed by time to learn and ask questions.

items.imageAlt: Colorful painting of one figure cradling another who is wrapped in a tallit
items.title: Room for family
items.text: Shabbat School for children, a welcoming Oneg lunch, and space for every generation to belong.

community.heading: Real people. Shared tables. Living worship.
community.intro: Life at TAJ is built through every generation learning, celebrating, and showing up for one another.

moments.imageAlt: Colorful painting of a woman cradling a white dove
moments.caption: Creativity that carries faith forward

moments.imageAlt: Colorful painting of two women resting their heads together in prayer shawls
moments.caption: Friendship through every season

location.body: Temple Aviv Judea is just a few blocks from downtown Fullerton. Come for Shabbat worship, stay for Oneg, and look for our sign between the trees.
location.imageAlt: The Temple Aviv Judea building at 704 East Commonwealth Avenue in Fullerton

ministriesPromo.heading: Community grows all week long.
ministriesPromo.body: There is a place here for every generation to learn, create, and serve together.
